method: Actual native AppKit application operated through CUA accessibility and screenshots. This UI session uses the final 1.6 renderer/controller and precedes the last Shedd contextual-building correction. Final package relaunch is recorded separately.
observations: App launched at Museum Campus with eight view cards and opening daytime idle cycle.
Key 5 selected the dome study and held the view; Space started the 180-second camera/show timeline and Space paused it.
Paused timeline 0.06265397199086793 remained unchanged across subsequent reads and N; settings showed Night selected and accumulation continued while paused.
With viewport focused, three distinct Right presses displayed Fast forward 2x,4x,8x; Left displayed Rewind 2x,4x,8x and decreasing timeline.
Up selected Adler exterior 04/08; Down returned to dome 05/08, both holding at time zero.
Right bracket increased idle 1x to 4x; I started view 08 of a night pass; subsequent screenshot showed a daytime pass after wrapping. Left bracket restored 1x and I held the view.
Control-Command-F entered native fullscreen, showed Exit Full Screen and widened the live viewport; repeating returned to the window.
Dragging the window corner resized the live viewport and layout. Controls and eight view cards remained visible and the projection kept its proportions.
Location menu contains Paris, Willis, Millennium Park, Chicago Lakefront and Museum Campus. Willis switch retained the same Chicago triangle count and allocations.
Both Chicago connecting flight menu entries started their intended locations/views: Millennium 08 at 04:00 and Campus 01 at 03:00. Night lighting persisted into both.
Paris loaded its nine views and 8,645,884 triangles with roughly 1.78 GB displayed allocations; returning to Campus completed loading and restored the city scene.
App quit after review to free the GPU for final rendering.
limits: Keyboard transport was exercised with the viewport focused; after a settings popover, clicking the viewport restored keyboard focus.
This was sampled UI observation, not a sustained frame-rate benchmark.
Later Shedd context geometry is outside this UI evidence snapshot; controller/shader input hashes make the scope explicit.
